method: Corrected Reels scenes and identities, authored Hindi adaptation, office combined-board workflow. No video renders verified.

records.title: The Kingdom Watches
local_shots: Title card only: FROST: SON OF THE WILD / Directed by Noorul Ain. Behind the text, a wide landscape view of L02_KingCastle at dusk, red banners moving in wind.
Wide shot, not close-up: workers, nobles, guards, and quiet families fill the square. Show faces worried, hands gripping each other, children held back.
King Magnus appears on the balcony in a medium-wide royal shot. Do not push camera into his face. Prince Damian stands half a step behind him, smiling politely.
Captain Vex and guards form a path through the crowd. Rose is visible only at the side near a stone arch, half-hidden, watching with fear. She does not enter the center.
Magnus raises one hand; the whole square becomes silent. The festival happiness feels fake, like everyone knows a secret rule.
Final image: Captain Vex lifts a sealed royal scroll. Hold on the scroll and the silent crowd, no random extra character.
records.next_opening: Start in the same castle square at dusk: Captain Vex already holding the sealed scroll in front of the crowd. Same red banners, same tense crowd.
spoken_hindi: थॉर्न राज्य में जश्न तो बस एक मुखौटा था।
आज रात हर परिवार ताज का हुक्म सुनेगा।
दरबार के सामने मुस्कुराओ। डर से अफवाहें फैलती हैं।

records.title: The Royal Proclamation
local_shots: Start in the same castle square at dusk: Captain Vex already holding the sealed scroll in front of the crowd. Same red banners, same tense crowd.
Close but not extreme: Vex breaks the seal. Guards stand behind him. Use S08_KingdomGuards_FULL exactly; no new armor design.
Cut to several worried family faces from S09_Brides_FULL group, but keep them background-style, not a new main heroine. No Lily yet.
King Magnus watches from balcony in a medium shot. Keep his full upper body visible; no giant face close-up.
A young woman from the brides group steps forward slowly with her family behind her. End on her hand trembling, not on violence.
records.previous_ending: Final image: Captain Vex lifts a sealed royal scroll. Hold on the scroll and the silent crowd, no random extra character.
records.next_opening: Begin inside the same crowd, tight on clasped hands, not a new location. A mother holds her daughter's wrist as the royal guards approach.
spoken_hindi: महाराज मैग्नस के आदेश से अब चुना हुआ नाम पुकारा जाएगा।
कोई खुश नहीं था। सब सोच रहे थे, अब कौन गायब होगा।
परंपरा मानने वालों की रक्षा ताज करता है।

records.title: A Mother's Tears
local_shots: Begin inside the same crowd, tight on clasped hands, not a new location. A mother holds her daughter's wrist as the royal guards approach.
Show the mother trying not to cry. Use S09_Brides_FULL as background bride-family reference; do not invent modern clothes.
The chosen young woman looks toward the forest gate beyond the castle walls. Keep the mood quiet, realistic, and painful.
Rose watches from behind a stone pillar on the side, half-hidden. She must not stand in the center, must not enter any bedroom, and must not dominate the scene.
Final image: the mother drops a small white handkerchief on the stone ground as guards guide the daughter away.
records.previous_ending: A young woman from the brides group steps forward slowly with her family behind her. End on her hand trembling, not on violence.
records.next_opening: Interior castle hall, landscape 16:9. Candlelight, long aisle, red banners. Continue with the chosen young woman now in a simple white royal gown.
spoken_hindi: महाराज, दया कीजिए। वह मेरी बेटी है।
तुम्हारी विनती दरबार ने सुन ली है।

records.title: Wedding Bells In A Silent City
local_shots: Interior castle hall, landscape 16:9. Candlelight, long aisle, red banners. Continue with the chosen young woman now in a simple white royal gown.
Wide aisle shot: Damian waits at the altar with a charming false smile. Keep him matching C03_PrinceDamian_FULL exactly.
The bride walks slowly. Her expression is scared, not romantic. Guests look down instead of smiling.
King Magnus watches from a raised seat in a medium-wide shot, hands on throne arms. No extreme face close-ups.
Final image: wedding bells ring, but the hall stays silent. The bride looks toward Rose hiding by a side doorway.
records.previous_ending: Final image: the mother drops a small white handkerchief on the stone ground as guards guide the daughter away.
records.next_opening: Start at the end of the ceremony in the same castle hall. Damian gently raises the bride's hand for the crowd.
spoken_hindi: शादी की घंटियाँ बजीं, लेकिन शहर में खुशी नहीं थी।
मेरे साथ खड़ी रहो। दरबार को सब ठीक दिखना चाहिए।

records.title: The Crown Smiles
local_shots: Start at the end of the ceremony in the same castle hall. Damian gently raises the bride's hand for the crowd.
Medium shot: Damian smiles for everyone. Keep the bride nervous and still. Do not make this romantic or playful.
King Magnus gives a small approving smile from his throne, shown from chest-up or wider, never extreme close-up.
Cut to Rose in the side shadows; she lowers her eyes and hides behind a curtain. She stays in servant position, not central.
Final image: the bride sees a locked black carriage waiting outside the castle window.
records.previous_ending: Final image: wedding bells ring, but the hall stays silent. The bride looks toward Rose hiding by a side doorway.
records.next_opening: Begin in a richly decorated sitting room beside the wedding hall. Damian offers the bride a cup of water from a tray.
spoken_hindi: देखा? राज्य तो बस तुम्हें खुश देखना चाहता है।
उस मुस्कान के पीछे एक बंद रास्ता छिपा था।

records.title: A Perfect Husband
local_shots: Begin in a richly decorated sitting room beside the wedding hall. Damian offers the bride a cup of water from a tray.
Medium two-shot, no touching beyond handing the cup. The bride stays tense, hands close to herself.
Damian speaks gently while castle servants move in background. The doorway stays empty; Rose is absent.
The bride almost relaxes, then hears a distant forest horn outside. Her face changes from confusion to fear.
Final image: Damian's smile fades for one second when he thinks no one is looking.
records.previous_ending: Final image: the bride sees a locked black carriage waiting outside the castle window.
records.next_opening: Start in the royal dining room, long table, candles, gold cups. Same castle, same night.
spoken_hindi: आज आराम करो। कल सब आसान लगेगा।
यहाँ कोई मुझसे नज़र क्यों नहीं मिलाता?

records.title: The Royal Toast
local_shots: Start in the royal dining room, long table, candles, gold cups. Same castle, same night.
King Magnus stands for a toast in a medium-wide shot. Show table and guests; do not crop to only his face.
Damian watches the bride over his cup. His smile is calm, but his eyes are cold.
The bride notices no other young wives at the table, only older servants and guards. Rose stands behind a chair in shadow.
Final image: Rose subtly taps one finger on a small key at her belt, warning the bride.
records.previous_ending: Final image: Damian's smile fades for one second when he thinks no one is looking.
records.next_opening: Begin in a candlelit servant corridor after dinner. Rose moves along the wall, keeping low and hidden.
spoken_hindi: थॉर्न की सुरक्षा, वफादारी और खामोशी के नाम।
मुझसे पहले आई औरतें कहाँ हैं?
कुछ सवाल अच्छी शाम बिगाड़ देते हैं।

records.title: Rose Knows
local_shots: Begin in a candlelit servant corridor after dinner. Rose moves along the wall, keeping low and hidden.
The bride follows at a distance. Guards pass in the foreground; Rose freezes behind hanging cloth.
Rose uses hand signals, pointing to a locked hallway and then toward the forest beyond a small window.
Keep Rose at the side of the frame, never entering a bedroom or taking over the bride's space. She is a hidden helper.
Final image: Rose slips a tiny brass key into the bride's folded sleeve and disappears into shadow.
records.previous_ending: Final image: Rose subtly taps one finger on a small key at her belt, warning the bride.
records.next_opening: Begin inside a royal bedroom with candles, heavy curtains, and a large carved bed. The bride sits alone at the edge, fully dressed, frightened.
spoken_hindi: ध्यान से देखो। यहाँ दीवारों के भी कान हैं।
सूरज निकलने के बाद क्या होगा?
उसका जवाब जंगल में छिपा है।

records.title: The Bridal Chamber
local_shots: Begin inside a royal bedroom with candles, heavy curtains, and a large carved bed. The bride sits alone at the edge, fully dressed, frightened.
Damian enters slowly and politely, staying several feet away. No touching, no explicit content, no romance pose.
He speaks gently while checking the door lock with his eyes. The bride notices the key hidden in her sleeve.
Rose must not enter the bedroom. Show only her shadow moving outside under the door crack, proving she is nearby but hidden.
Final image: the bride closes her hand around the hidden key as Damian turns toward the window.
records.previous_ending: Final image: Rose slips a tiny brass key into the bride's folded sleeve and disappears into shadow.
records.next_opening: Start after midnight in the same bedroom. Damian is gone. The bride stands barefoot near the door, holding Rose's brass key.
spoken_hindi: सो जाओ। सूरज उगने से पहले जंगल सुंदर लगता है।
मेरी सुरक्षा के लिए दरवाज़ा बंद करना क्यों ज़रूरी है?
उस रात ताज से ज़्यादा अहम एक चाबी थी।

records.title: The Locked Hallway
local_shots: Start after midnight in the same bedroom. Damian is gone. The bride stands barefoot near the door, holding Rose's brass key.
She unlocks the door quietly and enters a dark stone hallway. Use candlelight, shadows, and realistic fear.
The hallway walls show scratches, old ribbons, and broken hairpins from earlier brides. No gore, just evidence and dread.
A guard's lantern appears far behind her. Keep him distant; the suspense is the light approaching.
Final image: the bride finds a narrow servant stairway leading down toward the outer forest gate.
records.previous_ending: Final image: the bride closes her hand around the hidden key as Damian turns toward the window.
records.next_opening: Begin in the same cold castle corridor mood from Part 010: At the foot of the servant stairway, the bride notices muddy bootprints crossing toward the stable door. No time jump beyond late night turning into blue pre-dawn.
spoken_hindi: सुबह से पहले पश्चिमी गलियारा जाँच लेना।
उस चाबी ने महल का पहला झूठ खोल दिया।

records.title: Before Sunrise
local_shots: Begin in the same cold castle corridor mood from Part 010: At the foot of the servant stairway, the bride notices muddy bootprints crossing toward the stable door. No time jump beyond late night turning into blue pre-dawn.
Medium shot, not close-up: Damian enters a dim chamber, removes his wedding ring, and locks it inside a small drawer. His face stays calm but false.
The bride stands near the doorway in wedding clothes, confused and frightened. Rose and Magnus are absent from this scene.
Damian puts on dark riding gloves and opens the stable passage. Guards wait outside with lanterns, avoiding the bride's eyes.
Damian turns with a soft smile that feels dangerous and gestures toward the door. Final frame: the bride sees the black carriage waiting beyond the arch.
records.previous_ending: Final image: the bride finds a narrow servant stairway leading down toward the outer forest gate.
records.next_opening: Start directly on the black carriage wheels rolling over wet cobblestone outside the castle. Lantern light reflects in puddles.
spoken_hindi: मेरे साथ आओ। दरबार को हर बात जानने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
हम घंटियाँ बजने से पहले क्यों जा रहे हैं?

records.title: The Black Carriage
local_shots: Start directly on the black carriage wheels rolling over wet cobblestone outside the castle. Lantern light reflects in puddles.
Inside the carriage, medium shot: Damian sits composed in dark clothes. The bride sits opposite him, hands folded tightly, scared but silent.
Through the window, common people peek from dark homes and pull children away from the glass. No crowd chaos, only quiet fear.
Rose watches from a hidden service doorway as the carriage passes; she stays outside the action, half-covered by shadow.
The carriage leaves the last houses behind. Final frame: a child behind a curtain silently watches while the carriage disappears toward fog.
records.previous_ending: Damian turns with a soft smile that feels dangerous and gestures toward the door. Final frame: the bride sees the black carriage waiting beyond the arch.
records.next_opening: Continue from the carriage leaving town: the wheels move from cobblestone to muddy forest road under tall black pines.
spoken_hindi: काली गाड़ी को ज़ंजीरों की ज़रूरत नहीं थी। लोग उसका मतलब जानते थे।
बाहर देखो। डर के मारे कोई आवाज़ भी नहीं उठाएगा।

records.title: The Forbidden Road
local_shots: Continue from the carriage leaving town: the wheels move from cobblestone to muddy forest road under tall black pines.
Wide landscape shot: the castle lights vanish behind the carriage. The road ahead is swallowed by fog and huge trees.
The bride sees claw marks carved deep into bark and torn white cloth caught on a branch. Keep her face consistent with the bride reference.
The horses slow, ears pinned back. Guards exchange fearful looks but do not step away yet.
The carriage stops by itself. Final frame: the horses refuse to move, steam rising from their noses into the fog.
records.previous_ending: The carriage leaves the last houses behind. Final frame: a child behind a curtain silently watches while the carriage disappears toward fog.
records.next_opening: Start on iron forest gates half-buried in moss, black pines towering behind them. The carriage lanterns shake in the wind.
spoken_hindi: आखिरी घर के बाद, रास्ते का हर निशान एक चेतावनी था।
पेड़ों पर ये निशान किसने बनाए?
इस राज्य में सवाल जानवरों से ज़्यादा खतरनाक हैं।

records.title: The Forest Gate
local_shots: Start on iron forest gates half-buried in moss, black pines towering behind them. The carriage lanterns shake in the wind.
Guards step down and stop at the threshold. One guard refuses eye contact with the bride. No one crosses the gate.
Damian opens the carriage door himself. Medium shot: his polite mask is fading, but do not push into an extreme close-up.
The bride looks from Damian to the guards and understands they all know what this place means.
Damian points into the fog beyond the gate. Final frame: the bride stands on one side of the gate, Damian and the carriage on the other.
records.previous_ending: The carriage stops by itself. Final frame: the horses refuse to move, steam rising from their noses into the fog.
records.next_opening: Start with Damian's boots stepping backward from the bride as fog rolls between them at the forest gate.
spoken_hindi: जंगल के फाटक पर सैनिकों के कदम भी रुक गए।
इस फाटक के आगे कोई सवाल नहीं करता।
तुम मुझे जानबूझकर यहाँ लाए हो।

records.title: The Mask Falls
local_shots: Start with Damian's boots stepping backward from the bride as fog rolls between them at the forest gate.
Medium shot: Damian's polite smile disappears. He closes the carriage door without entering the forest.
The bride stands alone in her white dress at the edge of huge dark trees. Keep the camera respectful and non-exploitative.
Shadows move behind her in the fog. Only silhouettes and distant eyes, no clear creature reveal.
The carriage turns away, leaving her in the mist. Final frame: forest shadows move behind her as she turns toward the sound.
records.previous_ending: Damian points into the fog beyond the gate. Final frame: the bride stands on one side of the gate, Damian and the carriage on the other.
records.next_opening: Open on pale sunrise over the forest gate. The mist is thinner, the road is empty, and the carriage tracks are visible in mud.
spoken_hindi: वह शादी एक वादा नहीं, उसे यहाँ छोड़ने की साज़िश थी।
भागना है तो भागो। आगे जंगल तय करेगा।

records.title: The Forest Took Her
local_shots: Open on pale sunrise over the forest gate. The mist is thinner, the road is empty, and the carriage tracks are visible in mud.
Close detail shot: a crushed wedding flower lies beside deep footprints and scraped earth. No body, no gore.
Captain Vex kneels, studies the ground, and says nothing. Guards stand behind him with stiff faces.
Back at the castle square, bells begin ringing while citizens look down, pretending not to understand.
King Magnus stands on the balcony in medium-wide shot and gives a small order. Final frame: the kingdom bells swing above silent faces.
records.previous_ending: The carriage turns away, leaving her in the mist. Final frame: forest shadows move behind her as she turns toward the sound.
records.next_opening: Start in the castle square with bells still ringing from Part 016. Citizens gather but no one looks relieved.
spoken_hindi: सुबह तक दरबार अपना झूठ तय कर चुका था।
महाराज, फाटक पर कोई नहीं है।
घंटियाँ बजाओ। लोगों तक बस मेरी बात पहुँचे।

records.title: The Kingdom Lies
local_shots: Start in the castle square with bells still ringing from Part 016. Citizens gather but no one looks relieved.
Medium-wide balcony shot: King Magnus addresses the kingdom. Keep him imposing, not camera-filling.
Reaction shots: mothers pull daughters closer, men lower their eyes, guards stand like walls.
Rose watches from a servants' balcony, hidden behind stonework, horrified but silent. She does not come forward.
Damian stands behind Magnus with a bored, faint smile. Final frame: he turns and asks when the next selection begins.
records.previous_ending: King Magnus stands on the balcony in medium-wide shot and gives a small order. Final frame: the kingdom bells swing above silent faces.
records.next_opening: Start with a simple time passage: a calendar page turns from the last selection to one month later, then cut to the same castle square.
spoken_hindi: इस राज्य के शासक जानवरों से नहीं, सच से डरते थे।
वह अपने वचन तोड़कर जंगल भाग गई।

records.title: One Month Later
local_shots: Start with a simple time passage: a calendar page turns from the last selection to one month later, then cut to the same castle square.
Wide shot: the kingdom gathers again. Decorations are present, but the faces are tense and tired.
Damian sits at the royal table looking bored, turning a ring between his fingers as if this is routine.
Rose is hidden behind a side pillar, watching the young women with dread. She does not speak to the crowd.
Captain Vex steps forward with a new list. Final frame: the sealed list opens under the royal crest.
records.previous_ending: Damian stands behind Magnus with a bored, faint smile. Final frame: he turns and asks when the next selection begins.
records.next_opening: Start on the opened list in Vex's black-gloved hands. The names are written under poor districts and small houses.
spoken_hindi: एक महीने बाद, जश्न के साथ वही डर लौट आया।
यह रस्म इतनी लंबी क्यों होती है?

records.title: The Poor Names
local_shots: Start on the opened list in Vex's black-gloved hands. The names are written under poor districts and small houses.
Medium shot: Vex reads while guards scan the crowd. Families in plain clothes hold each other tightly.
King Magnus leans toward Damian in a controlled medium shot, explaining the choice without emotion.
Damian taps the parchment impatiently, searching for someone easy to erase from the kingdom's memory.
The list turns to a small Oregon town and then to the Carter family line. Final frame: Vex's finger moves toward Lily's name but does not land yet.
records.previous_ending: Captain Vex steps forward with a new list. Final frame: the sealed list opens under the royal crest.
records.next_opening: Start on a cross-cut: Vex's black-gloved finger hovers over the Carter family name, then cut to Lily's small home in warm morning light.
spoken_hindi: ताज उन्हें चुनता था जिनकी आवाज़ कोई नहीं सुनता।
गरीब परिवार सेना खड़ी नहीं कर सकते।

records.title: Lily Carter
local_shots: Start on a cross-cut: Vex's black-gloved finger hovers over the Carter family name, then cut to Lily's small home in warm morning light.
Inside L01_LilyHouse, Lily helps Grace fold cloth and prepare simple food. Lily must match C01_Lily_FULL exactly; Grace must match S01_GraceCarter_FULL.
Lily laughs softly with Grace, innocent and unaware. Their home feels poor but loving, with no palace luxury.
Cut back to the cold castle list. Magnus and Damian watch as Vex lowers his finger toward the final name.
Vex's black-gloved finger lands on 'लिली कार्टर।' Final frame: Lily looks up at home as if she felt something change.
records.previous_ending: The list turns to a small Oregon town and then to the Carter family line. Final frame: Vex's finger moves toward Lily's name but does not land yet.
records.next_opening: Continue from Part 020: Vex's black-gloved finger has just landed on Lily Carter's name. Cut to Vex closing the list and mounting his horse.
spoken_hindi: महल से दूर लिली कार्टर को अब भी सुबह सुरक्षित लगती थी।
लिली, बहुत काम कर लिया। थोड़ी देर मेरे पास बैठो।
बस यह पूरा कर लूँ, माँ। फिर बैठूँगी।

records.title: The Road To Lily
local_shots: Continue from Part 020: Vex's black-gloved finger has just landed on Lily Carter's name. Cut to Vex closing the list and mounting his horse.
Wide landscape shot: Vex and guards ride out of Thorne Castle toward a poor Oregon road. Keep armor and faces matched to reference images.
At L01_LilyHouse, Lily carries a water bucket and helps Grace with simple chores. Their home feels warm, poor, and real.
Neighbors hear royal hooves and quietly close doors and curtains. Nobody smiles; everyone knows what the sound means.
Grace looks out the window, sees royal riders approaching, and drops a cup. Final frame: Lily turns toward the broken cup.
records.previous_ending: Vex's black-gloved finger lands on 'लिली कार्टर।' Final frame: Lily looks up at home as if she felt something change.
records.next_opening: Start with Lily stepping into the castle square between guards. Grace is behind the guard line, trying to stay close.
spoken_hindi: शाही कागज़ पर लिखा नाम अब लिली के घर पहुँच रहा था।
कोई गलती नहीं। उसे दिन ढलने से पहले लाना है।

records.title: Chosen In Public
local_shots: Start with Lily stepping into the castle square between guards. Grace is behind the guard line, trying to stay close.
Wide shot of the public square: citizens stand in frightened silence, not celebration. King Magnus watches from above in a medium-wide shot.
Damian sees Lily and his polite smile becomes personal. Lily keeps her chin up but her eyes show fear.
Grace reaches forward from behind guards; Rose is hidden near a side pillar, looking devastated, not entering center stage.
Damian steps toward Lily and says she is the one. Final frame: Lily's face holds fear and disbelief as the crowd stays silent.
records.previous_ending: Grace looks out the window, sees royal riders approaching, and drops a cup. Final frame: Lily turns toward the broken cup.
records.next_opening: Continue from Damian naming Lily: Grace pushes against the guard line, reaching for her daughter.
spoken_hindi: सबके सामने चुने जाने से लिली आज़ाद नहीं हो गई थी।
माँ, ये लोग हमारे पास क्यों आ रहे हैं?

records.title: Grace Begs
local_shots: Continue from Damian naming Lily: Grace pushes against the guard line, reaching for her daughter.
Medium shot: Grace pleads with Captain Vex, but Vex keeps his arm firm across the path. He does not hurt her.
King Magnus watches from above, cold and still. Keep him in a controlled medium-wide royal shot.
Lily takes Grace's hand for one second through the guards and whispers courage, then the guards separate them.
Lily is led toward the castle stairs. Final frame: Grace is left behind, hand still raised in the air.
records.previous_ending: Damian steps toward Lily and says she is the one. Final frame: Lily's face holds fear and disbelief as the crowd stays silent.
records.next_opening: Start on Lily being led up the castle stairs from Part 023. Grace remains outside below, blocked by guards.
spoken_hindi: ग्रेस वहाँ गिड़गिड़ा रही थी जहाँ जवाब देना मना था।
मेरा सब कुछ ले लो, लेकिन मेरी बेटी को छोड़ दो।
माँ, साँस लो। मैं लौटने का रास्ता खोज लूँगी।

records.title: Into The Palace
local_shots: Start on Lily being led up the castle stairs from Part 023. Grace remains outside below, blocked by guards.
Lily enters the huge stone palace. Servants stop working and lower their eyes as she passes.
Damian walks ahead as if everything is normal. Lily notices servant hands trembling around flowers and white cloth.
Rose sees Lily from a side doorway and almost cries; she stays hidden at the edge, not in the middle of the hall.
Rose silently lowers her eyes as Lily turns toward her. Final frame: Lily realizes Rose knows something terrible.
records.previous_ending: Lily is led toward the castle stairs. Final frame: Grace is left behind, hand still raised in the air.
records.next_opening: Start in a dressing chamber with white fabric and flowers on a table. Lily sits still, not joyful, while maids work carefully.
spoken_hindi: महल में लिली का स्वागत नहीं, इंतज़ार हो रहा था।
ये पहरेदार मेरे पीछे क्यों चल रहे हैं?

records.title: The Beautiful Trap
local_shots: Start in a dressing chamber with white fabric and flowers on a table. Lily sits still, not joyful, while maids work carefully.
Use V01_Lily_Wedding for Lily's wedding look. Maids adjust the veil with shaking hands; Lily studies their faces.
Rose stands half-hidden near a wardrobe, watching but unable to speak openly. She does not take over the room.
Lily notices an old torn veil hidden under the table, stained only with dust and age, no blood.
A maid quickly snatches the old veil away. Final frame: Lily stares at the empty space where the veil was.
records.previous_ending: Rose silently lowers her eyes as Lily turns toward her. Final frame: Lily realizes Rose knows something terrible.
records.next_opening: Start with Lily in wedding clothes near a window, holding still as footsteps approach outside the room.
spoken_hindi: फूलों के पीछे जाल छिपाया गया था।
मेरी शादी में सब इतने डरे हुए क्यों हैं?

records.title: Damian's Gentle Voice
local_shots: Start with Lily in wedding clothes near a window, holding still as footsteps approach outside the room.
Damian enters with a gentle smile. Frame him in medium shot; do not make his face too close or romantic.
Damian speaks softly, offering false comfort. Lily wants to believe him but notices his eyes do not soften.
Rose appears in the doorway shadow behind Damian and silently shakes her head once, warning Lily.
Damian leaves with a final polite bow. Final frame: Lily sees Rose's warning eyes in the doorway.
records.previous_ending: A maid quickly snatches the old veil away. Final frame: Lily stares at the empty space where the veil was.
records.next_opening: Start at the wedding altar in the castle hall. Lily stands in V01_Lily_Wedding, tense and pale, with Damian beside her.
spoken_hindi: डेमियन जानता था, मीठी बात पर भरोसा जल्दी होता है।
आज मेरी बात मानना, लिली। सुरक्षित रहोगी।

records.title: I Do
local_shots: Start at the wedding altar in the castle hall. Lily stands in V01_Lily_Wedding, tense and pale, with Damian beside her.
Wide shot: citizens and servants watch silently. Grace is far back behind guards, not beside Lily.
Lily says the required words, voice small. Damian smiles for the crowd, polished and empty.
King Magnus watches from his royal seat in medium-wide shot. Rose moves at the side and slips a small key into Lily's folded shawl.
Lily feels the key hidden in the fabric. Final frame: Lily's hand closes over the key without anyone noticing.
records.previous_ending: Damian leaves with a final polite bow. Final frame: Lily sees Rose's warning eyes in the doorway.
records.next_opening: Start with Lily's hidden key in her shawl as Damian leads her toward a private royal room. Keep distance respectful.
spoken_hindi: लिली ने वचन दिए, भरोसा नहीं।
तो राज्य तुम्हारा स्वागत करता है।

records.title: The Private Room
local_shots: Start with Lily's hidden key in her shawl as Damian leads her toward a private royal room. Keep distance respectful.
The private room is beautiful but cold: candles, balcony doors, heavy curtains, no intimacy, no bed focus.
Damian speaks gently from across the room, pretending concern. Lily stays near the door, watchful.
Lily notices fresh scratches near the balcony lock and a damaged latch, like someone tried to escape before.
Damian tells her to sleep early for tomorrow's forest ride. Final frame: Lily looks from the scratched lock to the hidden key in her shawl.
records.previous_ending: Lily feels the key hidden in the fabric. Final frame: Lily's hand closes over the key without anyone noticing.
records.next_opening: Start with Damian's footsteps fading down the hallway outside Lily's private room. Lily stands by the scratched balcony lock.
spoken_hindi: निजी कमरे में भी डेमियन अपना अभिनय कर रहा था।
जल्दी आराम कर लो। कल तुम्हें जंगल दिखाऊँगा।
बालकनी के ताले पर खरोंचें क्यों हैं?

records.title: Rose Tells The Truth
local_shots: Start with Damian's footsteps fading down the hallway outside Lily's private room. Lily stands by the scratched balcony lock.
Rose appears at the door only after checking both sides of the corridor. She remains outside the doorway, frightened but determined; Lily approaches from inside.
Medium two-shot: Rose keeps her voice low and tells Lily that brides do not return from the forest ride.
Lily's fear turns into decision. She pulls the hidden key from her shawl while Rose points toward the servants' passage.
Bootsteps stop outside the door. Final frame: Rose withdraws into the corridor shadow; Lily freezes inside, eyes on the door handle.
records.previous_ending: Damian tells her to sleep early for tomorrow's forest ride. Final frame: Lily looks from the scratched lock to the hidden key in her shawl.
records.next_opening: Start with the door handle beginning to move. Rose pulls Lily into a side servant passage just before anyone enters.
spoken_hindi: रोज़ अब यह राज़ छिपाकर नहीं रख सकती थी।
सुबह की सवारी पर गई कोई दुल्हन नहीं लौटी।
तो मैं सुबह से पहले निकलूँगी।

records.title: Run Before Dawn
local_shots: Start with the door handle beginning to move. Rose pulls Lily into a side servant passage just before anyone enters.
Lily runs through narrow servant halls, holding her wedding dress up so she does not trip. Rose stays behind to mislead the guards.
Lily crosses a smoky kitchen and disappears through hanging laundry sheets. Keep movement clear in landscape frame.
Vex sees a curtain move and shouts for guards. Do not add extra speeches; let alarms and footsteps carry the chase.
Lily slips through the castle garden gate and reaches the dark forest edge before dawn. Final frame: she runs into the trees.
records.previous_ending: Bootsteps stop outside the door. Final frame: Rose withdraws into the corridor shadow; Lily freezes inside, eyes on the door handle.
records.next_opening: Medium side tracking shot of Lily running between wet trunks, holding her wedding skirt clear of her shoes. Keep face recognizable and natural, without an extreme close-up.
spoken_hindi: लिली ने अनजान जंगल का खतरा चुना।
पेड़ों की ओट मिलने तक रुकना मत।

records.title: Branches Like Hands
local_shots: Medium side tracking shot of Lily running between wet trunks, holding her wedding skirt clear of her shoes. Keep face recognizable and natural, without an extreme close-up.
A thin branch catches the hem. Lily stops and releases it by hand, leaving a small tear. The branch is ordinary wood and does not move independently.
She resumes running over exposed roots. Show grounded steps and strained breath. Preserve the tear, mud, hair and dress.
She reaches a large tree with an exposed root shelter, stops and listens. Bells fade behind her. An offscreen twig cracks ahead; show only her reaction.
One distant wolf howl sounds ahead. Lily crouches beside the gap beneath the roots, bracing one hand on wet bark. End on that crouched pose, looking toward the sound; do not reveal its source.
records.previous_ending: Lily slips through the castle garden gate and reaches the dark forest edge before dawn. Final frame: she runs into the trees.
records.next_opening: Lily crouches beside a root shelter before dawn, one hand on wet bark.

records.title: No Way Back
local_shots: Lily crouches beside a root shelter before dawn, one hand on wet bark.
She slides under the roots as torchlight approaches behind her.
Two guards pass on the path above; show their boots and matching armor, without seeing Lily.
Lily holds still until their light recedes. Her mouth remains closed.
She places her hand on damp ground and notices an old wolf paw print beside it. End on her hand and print.
records.previous_ending: One distant wolf howl sounds ahead. Lily crouches beside the gap beneath the roots, bracing one hand on wet bark. End on that crouched pose, looking toward the sound; do not reveal its source.
records.next_opening: Lily withdraws her hand from beside the wolf print beneath the roots.

records.title: Cold River Stones
local_shots: Lily withdraws her hand from beside the wolf print beneath the roots.
She leaves the hiding gap and follows the sound of flowing water to a narrow stream.
She steps across three exposed rocks, lifting her damp wedding skirt. Keep her balance plausible.
One shoe slips off into the current; show it drifting away. She reaches the opposite bank with one bare foot.
An unseen heavy splash sounds upstream. Lily turns toward ripples behind reeds; keep the source hidden.
records.previous_ending: She places her hand on damp ground and notices an old wolf paw print beside it. End on her hand and print.
records.next_opening: Lily stands on the stream bank, one shoe missing, reacting to upstream ripples.

records.title: The Hollow Tree
local_shots: Lily stands on the stream bank, one shoe missing, reacting to upstream ripples.
She moves away from the stream as light rain starts, finding a hollow fallen trunk nearby.
She crawls into its opening, keeping her muddy dress and bare foot consistent.
Inside, her fingers discover old claw marks in the bark. Show her face and the marks without altering her identity.
A grizzly passes outside, briefly blocking the opening. Lily freezes inside; the bear does not see her.
records.previous_ending: An unseen heavy splash sounds upstream. Lily turns toward ripples behind reeds; keep the source hidden.
records.next_opening: Lily remains inside the hollow trunk while the grizzly passes its opening.

records.title: Morning Without Home
local_shots: Lily remains inside the hollow trunk while the grizzly passes its opening.
The bear walks away. Show a short passage of time through rain easing and dawn light reaching the opening.
Lily emerges, still in the muddy torn wedding dress with one shoe missing. She examines a berry branch.
She hesitates to eat. A small ordinary forest bird pecks berries from that same branch; she takes only one cautiously.
A royal horn sounds in the distance. Lily drops her hand and turns toward it; end with berries still in her palm.
records.previous_ending: A grizzly passes outside, briefly blocking the opening. Lily freezes inside; the bear does not see her.
records.next_opening: Lily stands beside the berry branch, listening to a distant royal horn.
spoken_hindi: माँ को पता होता कि इनमें से कौन-से खाने लायक हैं।

records.title: Smoke In The Trees
local_shots: Lily stands beside the berry branch, listening to a distant royal horn.
She sees a thin smoke column through the trees and cautiously approaches, hoping to find shelter.
From behind a trunk she discovers Vex and two guards at a search camp; keep Lily concealed in the foreground.
She backs away. A small scrap from her torn veil remains caught on a branch near the path.
One guard lifts the scrap toward Vex. End on Vex studying the wedding fabric, Lily already out of sight.
records.previous_ending: A royal horn sounds in the distance. Lily drops her hand and turns toward it; end with berries still in her palm.
records.next_opening: Vex holds the wedding-silk scrap at the search camp in late afternoon.
spoken_hindi: कप्तान, यह शादी के जोड़े का रेशम है।

records.title: The Trackers
local_shots: Vex holds the wedding-silk scrap at the search camp in late afternoon.
He gestures two guards toward the narrow forest path. They inspect mud and find one shoe print beside a bare footprint.
Cut to Lily moving farther ahead, limping slightly on her bare foot. Preserve her face, torn dress and missing shoe.
Show the guards following slowly, then losing the trail among stones as daylight fades; no castle return.
As evening deepens, Lily stops beside a rocky clearing. A low wolf growl sounds just outside frame.
records.previous_ending: One guard lifts the scrap toward Vex. End on Vex studying the wedding fabric, Lily already out of sight.
records.next_opening: Lily stands in the rocky clearing at nightfall, facing an offscreen growl.
spoken_hindi: वह पानी पार कर गई है। किनारे पर खोजो।

records.title: The Wolf Circle
local_shots: Lily stands in the rocky clearing at nightfall, facing an offscreen growl.
Reveal exactly three wolves: one ahead, one to her left and one to her right. Keep each wolf in its established position.
She backs toward a steep rocky drop behind her. Show the drop clearly in a wider view; she does not fall.
The wolves take cautious steps forward as Lily braces against a rock, with no attack or contact.
A deep growl from the trees silences all three wolves. Their heads turn together toward it; leave the source unseen.
records.previous_ending: As evening deepens, Lily stops beside a rocky clearing. A low wolf growl sounds just outside frame.
records.next_opening: Lily braces against a rock by the steep drop while three wolves turn toward a deep growl.

records.title: The Grizzly Rises
local_shots: Lily braces against a rock by the steep drop while three wolves turn toward a deep growl.
A single grizzly emerges from the fog between Lily and the wolves. Establish all positions in one wide shot.
The three wolves retreat several steps toward the trees. The bear remains on all fours, realistically scaled.
Lily stays still against the rock as the bear turns its head toward her. Avoid comic expression or human behavior.
Trees behind the bear shake from an unseen heavy movement. The bear turns toward them; end on trembling branches.
records.previous_ending: A deep growl from the trees silences all three wolves. Their heads turn together toward it; leave the source unseen.
records.next_opening: Trees shake behind the grizzly; Lily remains at the rock near the drop and three wolves wait farther back.

records.title: The Black Giant
local_shots: Trees shake behind the grizzly; Lily remains at the rock near the drop and three wolves wait farther back.
Bruno steps from the moving branches, upright, with exact black fur, face and proportions from his reference. Keep his whole silhouette visible.
He places himself between Lily and the bear, leaving Lily space. He gives one powerful nonverbal roar; no words.
The grizzly backs away and the same three wolves retreat into the forest. No battle, injuries or extra animals.
Bruno turns slowly toward Lily with gentle eyes, hands lowered. Lily remains frightened but recognizes his protective position. End on their separated two-shot.
records.previous_ending: Trees behind the bear shake from an unseen heavy movement. The bear turns toward them; end on trembling branches.
records.next_opening: Bruno faces Lily beside the rocky drop after driving the animals away.

records.title: Bruno Speaks
local_shots: Bruno faces Lily beside the rocky drop after driving the animals away.
He kneels several steps away, hands lowered.
Lily studies his face as he introduces himself.
He offers to guide her home without moving closer.
Lily shakes her head, crying, still beside the rock.
records.previous_ending: Bruno turns slowly toward Lily with gentle eyes, hands lowered. Lily remains frightened but recognizes his protective position. End on their separated two-shot.
records.next_opening: Lily remains beside the rock, distressed by Bruno's offer.
spoken_hindi: मेरा नाम ब्रूनो है। मैं तुम्हें घर पहुँचा सकता हूँ।

records.title: Face to Face with a Grizzly
local_shots: Lily remains beside the rock, distressed by Bruno's offer.
A returning grizzly growls from the nearby brush; Bruno turns toward it.
Lily retreats along the rock wall rather than running back to the castle.
The bear emerges on all fours and rears as Bruno steps between them.
End on the bear raising one forepaw toward Bruno, Lily safely behind him.
records.previous_ending: Lily shakes her head, crying, still beside the rock.
records.next_opening: The grizzly's raised forepaw comes toward Bruno, Lily behind him.

records.title: The Shadow Arrives
local_shots: The grizzly's raised forepaw comes toward Bruno, Lily behind him.
Bruno blocks its forearm with one hand, grounded on both feet.
He redirects the bear away from Lily and releases it without injury.
The bear retreats into the trees; Lily watches Bruno lower his hands.
Bruno turns gently toward Lily; she remains frightened but stops backing away.
records.previous_ending: End on the bear raising one forepaw toward Bruno, Lily safely behind him.
records.next_opening: Bruno turns toward Lily after the bear retreats.

records.title: He Can Talk?!
local_shots: Bruno turns toward Lily after the bear retreats.
Lily steadies herself against the rock and checks her bare foot.
Bruno gives her room and offers a route to shelter.
She recognizes that he understands her words, lowering her defensive hands.
A twig snaps farther along the path; both turn toward it.
records.previous_ending: Bruno turns gently toward Lily; she remains frightened but stops backing away.
records.next_opening: Lily and Bruno face the sound along the forest path.
spoken_hindi: तुम मेरी हर बात समझ रहे थे?
हाँ। पानी के उस पार एक सुरक्षित जगह है।

records.title: Hold On!
local_shots: Lily and Bruno face the sound along the forest path.
One mountain lion appears on a low branch and leaps toward Bruno.
Bruno shields Lily and deflects the animal onto soft ground; it retreats.
Lily accepts his offered arm; he supports her as they descend a bank.
They step into a shallow pool beneath a waterfall, creating a large splash.
records.previous_ending: A twig snaps farther along the path; both turn toward it.
records.next_opening: Bruno supports Lily in the shallow waterfall pool after their descent.

records.title: The Cave Behind the Waterfall
local_shots: Bruno supports Lily in the shallow waterfall pool after their descent.
He guides her along a visible rock ledge behind the falling water.
The cave opens beyond the water curtain; show its dry interior and open mouth.
He helps her sit on a dry moss-covered stone, then backs away.
Bruno looks out through the water curtain while Lily warms her hands in her lap.
records.previous_ending: They step into a shallow pool beneath a waterfall, creating a large splash.
records.next_opening: Lily sits on the dry cave stone while Bruno watches the waterfall entrance.
spoken_hindi: इस जगह को कोई और भी जानता है?

records.title: I Can't Go Back
local_shots: Lily sits on the dry cave stone while Bruno watches the waterfall entrance.
She asks him to listen; he sits at a respectful distance.
She explains that the crown will find her at her mother's house.
Bruno offers the cave as shelter, leaving its entrance unblocked.
Lily reaches for his lowered finger; he lets her hold it without pulling her closer.
records.previous_ending: Bruno looks out through the water curtain while Lily warms her hands in her lap.
records.next_opening: Lily releases Bruno's finger inside the cave.
spoken_hindi: वे सबसे पहले मेरी माँ के घर तलाश करेंगे।
जब तक खतरा टल न जाए, यहीं रहो।

records.title: The Safe Distance
local_shots: Lily releases Bruno's finger inside the cave.
He walks toward a stone shelf and sets down a small handful of fruit.
He steps away, keeping the exit and her line of sight clear.
Lily examines one piece before taking a cautious bite.
She watches him sitting across the cave; her shoulders begin to relax.
records.previous_ending: Lily reaches for his lowered finger; he lets her hold it without pulling her closer.
records.next_opening: Lily finishes a bite inside the cave as Bruno turns toward the entrance.
spoken_hindi: मैं इसे यहीं रख देता हूँ।
मुझे थोड़ा समय देने के लिए शुक्रिया।

records.title: Fire Without Fear
local_shots: Lily finishes a bite inside the cave as Bruno turns toward the entrance.
He gathers dry sticks under the rock overhang and lights a small sheltered fire.
Lily watches from the cave mouth while rain begins beyond the overhang.
Later that night, he rests outside the dry sleeping area, leaving it to her.
Lily draws the entrance's hanging reed screen slightly aside to check on him; no wooden door appears.
records.previous_ending: She watches him sitting across the cave; her shoulders begin to relax.
records.next_opening: Next morning Lily steps through the reed screen; Bruno rises by the cold fire.

records.title: The Wrong Berries
local_shots: Next morning Lily steps through the reed screen; Bruno rises by the cold fire.
She gathers a few unfamiliar berries beside the cave path.
Before she eats one, Bruno gently brushes the handful away.
He shows a different berry cluster and lets her compare the leaves.
His restrained expression of disgust at the first cluster makes Lily laugh.
records.previous_ending: Lily draws the entrance's hanging reed screen slightly aside to check on him; no wooden door appears.
records.next_opening: Lily's laughter fades as she carries the safe berries toward a quiet river with Bruno.
spoken_hindi: इन्हें खाने से पेट में दर्द होगा।
इतने सारे तोड़ने से पहले बता देते।

records.title: River Lesson
local_shots: Lily's laughter fades as she carries the safe berries toward a quiet river with Bruno.
He demonstrates waiting still beside a shallow pool before catching one fish.
Lily imitates his stance but reaches too quickly.
She slips on a wet stone; his open hand supports her forearm until she regains balance.
They exchange a shy look and then turn back toward the water.
records.previous_ending: His restrained expression of disgust at the first cluster makes Lily laugh.
records.next_opening: Next morning Lily sits by the cave entrance, watching Bruno prepare breakfast.
spoken_hindi: मछलियाँ मेरे हाथों से तेज़ हैं।

records.title: Bigfoot Breakfast
local_shots: Next morning Lily sits by the cave entrance, watching Bruno prepare breakfast.
He places one live salmon on a flat stone; it flops toward her knees.
Lily shifts aside as Bruno catches the fish and sets it in a water basin.
He offers a small honeycomb instead, with a few bees following it.
One bee lands on his nose; he holds still while Lily gently wafts it away.
records.previous_ending: They exchange a shy look and then turn back toward the water.
records.next_opening: Lily wafts a bee away from Bruno beside the breakfast stone.
spoken_hindi: नाश्ता भागने की कोशिश कर रहा है।

records.title: The First Argument
local_shots: Lily wafts a bee away from Bruno beside the breakfast stone.
Bruno offers a leaf containing an edible insect from his own meal.
Lily politely refuses, then firmly stops him offering it again.
He understands, sets his own food aside and brings the familiar fruit bowl.
They share berries beside the sheltered fire with their preferences respected.
records.previous_ending: One bee lands on his nose; he holds still while Lily gently wafts it away.
records.next_opening: Later that day Lily and Bruno leave the cave for a leafy clearing.
spoken_hindi: तुम्हें पसंद है तो खाओ। मुझे नहीं चाहिए।
तो लिली के हिस्से में और बेर आएँगे।

records.title: The Vine Fall
local_shots: Later that day Lily and Bruno leave the cave for a leafy clearing.
Lily tests a low hanging vine while Bruno stands close enough to assist.
She swings only a short distance, loses her grip and lands in a deep leaf pile.
Bruno rushes over; she sits up unhurt and laughs at her leafy hair.
A distant royal horn interrupts their laughter; both turn toward the trees.
records.previous_ending: They share berries beside the sheltered fire with their preferences respected.
records.next_opening: Bruno listens toward the horn while Lily stands beside the leaf pile.
spoken_hindi: बस मेरी अकड़ को चोट लगी है।

records.title: Tracks Near The Cave
local_shots: Bruno listens toward the horn while Lily stands beside the leaf pile.
They return by a sheltered path and notice armored bootprints near the waterfall.
Bruno examines the prints and guides Lily behind a large stone.
He points toward a concealed route they can use before sunrise.
A torch flickers across the river; both stay concealed.
records.previous_ending: A distant royal horn interrupts their laughter; both turn toward the trees.
records.next_opening: Across the river a guard holds the torch seen from the cave.
spoken_hindi: वे और पास आए तो सुबह से पहले निकलेंगे।

records.title: The Hunt Begins
local_shots: Across the river a guard holds the torch seen from the cave.
Vex studies the boot trail and a fragment of Lily's veil at a small search camp.
Cut briefly to Damian receiving a report at the castle; he orders the search continued.
Return to the camp where Vex presents the fabric to one armored dark Bigfoot tracker.
The tracker smells the fabric and points toward the waterfall; do not show Lily at the camp.
records.previous_ending: A torch flickers across the river; both stay concealed.
records.next_opening: Before sunrise Lily and Bruno use the concealed route away from the cave.
spoken_hindi: सबूत लाओ, एक और बहाना नहीं।
झरने के पास निशान खत्म हो जाते हैं।

records.title: The Vine Swing
local_shots: Before sunrise Lily and Bruno use the concealed route away from the cave.
They reach a river crossing with a strong hanging vine and a safe shallow landing.
Bruno tests the vine before Lily swings across a short gap to the bank.
He attempts the crossing next, misjudges his landing and splashes into shallow water.
He surfaces with a loose fish briefly on his head; Lily laughs from the bank, then they continue.
records.previous_ending: The tracker smells the fabric and points toward the waterfall; do not show Lily at the camp.
records.next_opening: After checking the concealed route, Lily and Bruno return toward the cave to collect supplies.
spoken_hindi: तुम्हें ठीक से उतरना अभी सीखना पड़ेगा।

records.title: They Found Us
local_shots: After checking the concealed route, Lily and Bruno return toward the cave to collect supplies.
Lily washes fruit at the pool while Bruno watches the far bank.
Vex, two guards and the single armored dark Bigfoot approach across the water.
Bruno motions Lily behind the rock curtain, then faces the tracker.
End with Bruno and the tracker facing each other across the waterfall pool; Lily stays concealed.
records.previous_ending: He surfaces with a loose fish briefly on his head; Lily laughs from the bank, then they continue.
records.next_opening: Bruno and the armored tracker face each other across the pool.

records.title: Bigfoot vs Bigfoot
local_shots: Bruno and the armored tracker face each other across the pool.
The tracker advances; Bruno tackles it into shallow water with clear grounded contact.
They struggle briefly, then Bruno pins its shoulder against a rock and releases it as it yields.
The tracker retreats; Bruno roars once toward Vex and the two guards.
The guards retreat with Vex, carrying their torches away; Bruno turns back toward Lily's hiding place.
records.previous_ending: End with Bruno and the tracker facing each other across the waterfall pool; Lily stays concealed.
records.next_opening: Bruno checks Lily behind the waterfall after the search party retreats.

records.title: The Hidden Meadow
local_shots: Bruno checks Lily behind the waterfall after the search party retreats.
They leave by the concealed route to a meadow, carrying only a small food bundle.
At dusk he parts branches to reveal wildflowers and fireflies.
Lily walks into the clearing, relieved, with Bruno several steps behind.
A rustle beyond the flowers catches his attention; show no soldier or new threat yet.
records.previous_ending: The guards retreat with Vex, carrying their torches away; Bruno turns back toward Lily's hiding place.
records.next_opening: Bruno checks the meadow rustle and finds ordinary leaves moving in the wind.
spoken_hindi: मुझे नहीं पता था कोई जगह इतनी शांत हो सकती है।

records.title: The Honey Tree
local_shots: Bruno checks the meadow rustle and finds ordinary leaves moving in the wind.
Next morning he takes Lily toward a honey tree to cheer her.
He collects a small honeycomb but disturbs a few bees and retreats.
Lily waits until the bees disperse, then presses a cool damp cloth to his nose.
Their hands touch over the cloth, and both hold still.
records.previous_ending: A rustle beyond the flowers catches his attention; show no soldier or new threat yet.
records.next_opening: Lily lowers the damp cloth from Bruno's nose as wind rises.
spoken_hindi: तुम भी मधुमक्खियों से बहस नहीं कर सकते।

records.title: The Storm Shelter
local_shots: Lily lowers the damp cloth from Bruno's nose as wind rises.
They return to the waterfall cave before heavy rain begins.
Thunder traps them under the cave overhang; he checks the entrance stones.
Lily admits that losing his friendship frightens her more than the thunder.
Bruno sits nearby and stays with her while rain fills the view outside.
records.previous_ending: Their hands touch over the cloth, and both hold still.
records.next_opening: Lily and Bruno sit in the cave as the storm eases.
spoken_hindi: मैं फिर अकेली नहीं रहना चाहती।

records.title: The Song From Home
local_shots: Lily and Bruno sit in the cave as the storm eases.
She folds the damp cloth and begins a quiet song her mother taught her.
